title: Capture ingestion
responsibility: Validates a check capture index, rejects redirected or oversized evidence, hashes files within capture and record budgets, and returns record-ready captures or explicit failures.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.directory
inputs.description: The check's evidence directory, holding the captures.ndjson index and the plain file names its valid lines declare. A missing directory or index yields no captures and no failure; a symlink or non-directory on the path to it, a non-regular index, or an index over 2,000,000 bytes is refused with one failure and none of its captures are read.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.recordPath
inputs.description: Record-relative prefix prepended, with a slash, to each admitted capture's file name to form its recorded path. The check runner passes evidence/<commit>/<scenario or checks>/<leaf>, and a refusal for the record's total budget quotes that same path.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.limits
inputs.description: Optional byte caps from harness.verify.json: maxCaptureBytes refuses any single capture file larger than it, and maxRecordBytes refuses a capture that would take the record's retained total past it. An absent cap means no limit, so the default {} caps nothing.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.scope
inputs.description: Optional shared RecordBudget that accounts for retained bytes across one verification record, and the trusted run root, beneath which every existing component down to the directory must be a real directory and not a symlink. An absent budget is made from limits.maxRecordBytes, and an absent root is the directory itself.

inputs.name: gatherLine.scope
inputs.type: { recordPath: string; limits: CaptureLimits; budget: RecordBudget }

inputs.name: posterBudget.line
inputs.description: Video capture declaration containing its required poster filename, size and hash.

inputs.name: posterBudget.file
inputs.description: Path of the regular video file whose poster is stored in the same evidence directory.

inputs.name: posterBudget.scope
inputs.type: { budget: RecordBudget; limits: CaptureLimits; videoBytes: number }
inputs.description: Shared record budget, per-capture byte limits and admitted video byte count for atomic pair admission.

inputs.name: inspectVideoPoster.line
inputs.description: Video capture metadata naming the poster and its representative video timestamp.

inputs.name: inspectVideoPoster.file
inputs.description: Admitted video file used to extract the actual representative frame for pixel comparison.

inputs.name: inspectVideoPoster.facts
inputs.description: Decoded media facts; undefined or non-video facts are rejected.

outputs.name: gatherCaptures
outputs.description: Each admitted capture becomes a Gathered entry with its CaptureLine, its record-ready Capture (status 'passed' here, decided later) and any media facts (an {error} entry for unsupported or invalid media) or parsed benchmark (undefined when the file is not JSON). failures carries one string for each malformed line, missing file, symlink, over-budget or unreadable capture, and for a refused directory or index.

failures: declared capture evidence-grid-empty.png but wrote no file
left capture evidence-grid-loaded.png of 9437184 bytes, over maxCaptureBytes 5242880 in harness.verify.json; it was not recorded

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Video inputs, recording tools, poster media or evidence limits cannot satisfy the declared recording contract.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid or oversized indexes and child sidecars are either reported as admission failures or thrown by the low-level descriptor helpers.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown inside this unit when lstat does not report a capture as a regular file, when a media or benchmark capture's read returns no contents, and when the capture directory or index is not a regular directory or regular file. gatherLine and indexLines catch every such throw and report it as a failure string, so gatherCaptures never throws it.
